semantic.justification: Task AQF9AG maps ScAsciiOptions CSV option parsing to the existing Calc document and file-dialog path. Numeric option tokens use the source o3tl::toInt32 prefix, overflow and narrowing behavior; source defaults, delimiter weighting and surplus-token tolerance are represented. ScImportExport::SetExtOptions copies ScAsciiOptions and its column metadata as the native owned value does. Task AQF9AG retains UTF-16 separator serialization and forwards DETECT separator input to SfxObjectShell::DetectCsvSeparators. ICU-based charset guessing, formatter-driven date/currency classification, rich edit-text, the native options dialog and the complete text filter remain incomplete and are not claimed as parity.
